adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a new fallback path in `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents` that, when a `destination.credentialId` is present but not found in `this.calendarCredentials`, calls `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: destination.credentialId } })` and then uses that credential to `createEvent(...)`. This lookup is by raw numeric id with no `userId`/`teamId`/org scoping, whereas the prior behavior only ever used credentials already present in `this.calendarCredentials` (implicitly scoped to the EventManager context). As written, any stale/incorrect/maliciously-associated `credentialId` on a `DestinationCalendar` object would be trusted and could cause event creation using an unrelated credential, which is a concrete broken authorization boundary introduced by this change.
